questions.stem: A patient with a known macroprolactinoma (2.5 cm) not on any treatment presents with worsening headache with sudden loss of vision followed by impaired consciousness. Examination shows ophthalmoplegia and CT reveals hemorrhage within the tumor. What is the next best step?
